captions: 7:52 p.m. Your room in a new city. Week three.
You scroll. Too late. Too busy. Too long ago.
On the shelf: the Quran your mum packed. Dust on top.
Inside, your name. In her handwriting.
8:41 p.m. Isha. A masjid around the corner.
A stranger makes space for you in the row.
After salam, you raise your hands. And you talk.
